title: Khayyam Challenge (PersianMMLU): Is Your LLM Truly Wise to The Persian Language?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of large language models on an originally curated, non-translated dataset of Persian multiple-choice questions (Khayyam Challenge) to assess their comprehension of the Persian language and its cultural nuances, highlighting performance gaps compared to English-centric benchmarks.

Analyzing the distribution of multiple-choice options selected by various models to identify whether they disproportionately favor specific choice positions (e.g., the second or third options) instead of aligning with the ground truth distribution.
